Please Try Again. Powered by Reelgood If you’re not fully caught up on The Pitt Season 2, you’re probably going to want to fix that ASAP. Tonight, The Pitt Season 2 Episode 11 “5 PM” hits HBO Max, firmly establishing a tradition for the show wherein Episode 11 is where the proverbial shit hits the fan. The Pitt Season 2 has already been steadily grinding its characters down to a pulp. Dr. Robby (Noah Wyle) is doing his best to get through his last shift before a three month sabbatical, head charge nurse Dana (Katherine La Nasa) is still processing the trauma of being assaulted last season, and the threat of cyber attacks has forced the hospital to shut down its internet, pushing the team to go full analog. Add to that a stressful deposition, the return of a newly sober Langdon (Patrick Ball), and the usual chaos of a hectic Fourth of July weekend, and you’ve got a recipe for unmitigated disaster. So what else could possibly go wrong on The Pitt? What fresh hell will the doctors and nurses of PTMC have to face? Here’s everything you need to know about how to watch the next episode of The Pitt… Photo: HBO Max When Does The Next Episode of The Pitt Come Out? The Pitt Season 2 Episode 11 “5 PM” Release Date: The Pitt Season 2 Episode 11 “5 PM” will premiere on HBO MAX on Thursday, March 19. What Time Is The Pitt On Tonight? The Pitt Season 2 Episode 11 “5 PM” will be streaming tonight, Thursday, March 19, at 9 PM ET (or 6 PM PT) on HBO MAX. Most new episodes of HBO MAX originals now hit the streaming service at 9 PM ET/6 PM PT. Photo: HBO Max How Many Episodes Are in The Pitt? The Pitt Season 2 Episode Guide: There are a total of 15 episodes in The Pitt Season 2. New episodes of The Pitt come out on Thursdays between now and April 16. Don’t want to miss a single minute of the action? Here’s your guide to when every episode of The Pitt Season 2 is coming out: Season 2 Episode 1 “7 AM”: Thursday, January 8 Season 2 Episode 2 “8 AM”: Thursday, January 15 Season 2 Episode 3 “9 AM”: Thursday, January 22 Season 2 Episode 4 “10 AM”: Thursday, January 29 Season 2 Episode 5 “11 AM”: Thursday, February 5 Season 2 Episode 6 “12 PM”: Thursday, February 12 Season 2 Episode 7 “1 PM”: Thursday, February 19 Season 2 Episode 8 “2 PM”: Thursday, February 26 Season 2 Episode 9 “3 PM”: Thursday, March 5 Season 2 Episode 10 “4 PM”: Thursday, March 12 Season 2 Episode 11 “5 PM”: Thursday, March 19 Season 2 Episode 12 “6 PM”: Thursday, March 26 Season 2 Episode 13 “7 PM”: Thursday, April 2, 9 PM ET Season 2 Episode 14 “8 PM”: Thursday, April 9, 9 PM ET Season 2 Episode 15 “9 PM”: Thursday, April 16, 9 PM ET Photo: HBO Max Will There Be a Third Season of The Pitt? The Pitt Season 3 Release Date: HBO Max has already renewed The Pitt for a third season. The Pitt Season 3 is expected to come out in January 2027. Is There a Trailer for The Pitt Season 2? Yes, there definitely is. You can watch The Pitt Season 2 trailer by scrolling to the top of this page. The Pitt Season 2 Cast Guide: HBO Max’s The Pitt features a massive ensemble cast of actors, some of whom you might already know from projects like The Librarians, Imposters, The Deuce, Chucky, For All Mankind, The Gilded Age, or Star Trek: Picard.
